![Amazon's Mechanical Turk is being wound down. Image from [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/off-prem/2026/07/03/amazons-mechanical-turk-to-stop-accepting-new-customers-and-not-even-ai-can-save-it/5266274).](cover.jpg){fig-align="center"}

> Earlier this week, AWS added the Amazon SageMaker AI – Mechanical Turk service to its list of "Services in Maintenance" – AWS-speak for services it will soon retire. The Mechanical Turk website also added a warning that it will "be closed to new customers, effective July 30, 2026. Existing users will not be impacted by this change."

Oh wow — end of an era.

Amazon's Mechanical Turk to stop accepting new customers – and not even AI can save it - The Register <https://www.theregister.com/off-prem/2026/07/03/amazons-mechanical-turk-to-stop-accepting-new-customers-and-not-even-ai-can-save-it/5266274>
